Exchange/platform: KuCoin
Headline: ChartControl AI x KuCoin Special Trading Competition Is Live!
Prize pool: 10K USDT
Start: 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-15T15:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 2000 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 50 USDT (deposit)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Thank you for trading with KuCoin. We're excited to announce that we have deepened our partnership with ChartControl AI!
To celebrate this collaboration, we are launching an exclusive trading competition with a dynamic prize pool of up to 10,000 USDT. The final rewards will be unlocked based on the total trading volume generated by all registered participants during the campaign.
The more the community trades together, the bigger the rewards unlocked for everyone.
In addition to the trading competition, both new and existing users can enjoy more bonuses during the campaign period. Don't miss this opportunity to trade and earn more with ChartControl AI and KuCoin.
Join Now!
## Event Details
Event Period: From 00:00 on November 16, 2026 to 23:59 December 15, 2026 (UTC+8)
## Eligible Users
Users registered via ChartControl AI's Broker referral code or using the terminal of ChartControl AI
## Event Rule
## Trading Competition — Prize Pool Up to 10,000 USDT
To qualify for the leaderboard, participants must achieve a minimum eligible trading volume of 100,000 USDT during the campaign period.
The final prize pool will be determined based on the total eligible trading volume generated by all registered participants.
## Stage 1 — Basic Prize Pool (3,000 USDT)
If the total eligible trading volume of all registered participants does not exceed 10,000,000 USDT, a 3,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked.
## Top 1–30 users on the leaderboard will each receive:
100 USDT Futures Trial Funds
## Stage 2 — Full Prize Pool (10,000 USDT)
If the total eligible trading volume of all registered participants exceeds 10,000,000 USDT, the full 10,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked.
## Top 30 Rewards:
1st Place: 2,000 USDT Futures Trial Funds
2nd Place: 1,400 USDT Futures Trial Funds
3rd Place: 800 USDT Futures Trial Funds
4th–10th Place: 400 USDT Futures Trial Funds each
11th–30th Place: 150 USDT Futures Trial Funds each
The higher your trading volume, the higher your ranking and rewards.
## More benefits for ChartControl AI users
General Cashback: All eligible users will enjoy 5% commission-sharing on trades during the event
- Exclusive New User Rewards: Up to 550 USDT welcome gifts per user
New users who register for a KuCoin account using ChartControl AI's broker referral code (R-code) and complete the following tasks can unlock exclusive rewards.
## One-Time Deposit Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC within 14 days, and deposit at least 50 USDT can earn:
- Spot trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT + Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT
## One-Time Tiered Trade Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC and deposit within 14 days, and reach the following Spot + Futures trading volumes can unlock corresponding rewards:
- Trading volume ≥ 1,000 USDT: Interest-Free Coupon worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 5,000 USDT: VIP3 benefits voucher
- Trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT: Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 200 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 40,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 100,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 150 USDT
## Note:
1. The full 10,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked only if the total event trading volume exceeds 10,000,000 USDT.
2. Only users with an eligible trading volume of at least 100,000 USDT will qualify for the leaderboard.
3. Rankings will be determined based on each participant's eligible trading volume.
4. The top 30 on the leaderboard who meet the eligibility requirements will be rewarded.
5. Final reward distribution depends on the prize pool unlock stage achieved during the event.
Learn more abount the campaign.
## About ChartControl AI
ChartControl AI is a web-based charting and AI-assisted trading terminal for crypto: real-time chart analysis, 100+ indicators, custom strategies and signals you can build with AI, auto-trading bots, a market scanner and trade reviews.

Exchange/platform: Aster
Headline: Anthropic Pre-IPO Showdown: 20,000 USDT Taker & PnL Clash
Prize pool: 20K USDT
Start: 2026-11-13T14:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-12T23:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 50 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 50000 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
With Anthropic’s IPO on the horizon, market anticipation is heating up. Now, get ahead of the buzz with Aster!
Trade $ANT (Anthropic) in Aster’s Anthropic Pre-IPO Showdown, climb the leaderboard, and compete for your share of the 20,000 USDT prize pool.
## 🔍 What Is a Pre-IPO Perpetual
A Pre-IPO Perpetual trades on the market-implied price per share of a company that has not listed yet. These contracts do not represent equity or any claim on shares.
## Campaign Overview
- Eligible perpetual contract: ANTHROPICUSD1 (ANTUSD1), ANTHROPICUSDT (ANTUSDT)
- Campaign period: November 13, 14:00 UTC — December 12, 23:59 UTC
- Prize pool: 20,000 USDT
## Prize Pool Breakdown
## The 20,000 USDT prize pool is allocated as follows:
- Cumulative Taker Volume Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
- Absolute Net USD PnL Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
- Participation Pool: 4,000 USDT
Participants’ rankings will be displayed on the campaign landing page throughout the campaign period. If fewer eligible traders meet the minimum cumulative trading volume requirement, any unawarded rewards will not be distributed.
## 1. Cumulative Taker Volume Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
40% of the prize pool (8,000 USDT) will be awarded to the Top 5 traders ranked by cumulative single-sided taker volume executed across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
## Eligibility Requirements
To qualify for leaderboard rewards, users must meet the minimum cumulative taker trading volume requirement for their respective rank across the eligible trading pairs, as shown in the table below.
If these requirements are not met, the corresponding leaderboard rewards will not be awarded.
## 2. Absolute Net USD PnL Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
40% of the prize pool (8,000 USDT) will be awarded to the Top 5 traders ranked by net trading profit (Realized + Unrealized USD PnL, net of funding and trading fees) across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
- If a trader ranks by PnL without meeting the tier’s minimum volume requirement, they step down to the highest tier whose volume guardrail they satisfied.
- PnL will only be calculated for positions opened during the campaign period.
- Participants may win rewards from both leaderboards if they meet the eligibility requirements.
## 3. Participation Pool: 4,000 USDT
20% of the prize pool (4,000 USDT) will be shared equally among eligible participants, with each participant receiving up to 50 USDT.
- Achieve a cumulative taker trading volume of at least $50,000 USD across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
- Not receive rewards from Taker Volume or PnL leaderboards.
## Note
- The campaign is open to all new and existing Aster users, excluding market makers.
- Sub-accounts are not eligible for separate registration. Trading volume generated by all sub-accounts will be automatically consolidated under the corresponding main account.
- Participation in this campaign requires Account Privacy to be disabled. Participants’ wallet addresses and trading volumes will be publicly displayed.
- Only trades executed on eligible trading pairs via Aster Perpetuals during the campaign period will be counted toward reward calculations, including trades made through Binance Wallet, Trust Wallet, SafePal, and other supported channels.
- Only reward amounts equal to or greater than 1 USDT will be distributed. Rewards will be distributed to participants’ Aster Perpetual accounts within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
- As Anthropic’s IPO approaches, Aster reserves the right to rebase its Pre-IPO Perpetual contracts. Traders may need to close existing positions and reopen them. Please monitor official announcements and adjust your positions accordingly to avoid potential losses.
- Trading volume and realized PnL from the eligible Pre-IPO Perpetuals pair will continue to count toward the campaign leaderboard calculations following its transition to a regular Perpetuals pair during the campaign period.
## Terms & Conditions
- Activities identified as wash trading, self-trading, manipulative volume generation, wallet-splitting, or any other abusive behaviors will result in disqualification. Sybil farming behaviors will be filtered.
- Due to the inherent volatility of digital asset markets, returns from any Aster trading campaign may fluctuate and are not guaranteed.
- Aster may amend or modify campaign rules at any time without prior notice.
- Aster retains the final right of interpretation for this event.
- Aster will not be responsible or liable for any losses (including, without limitation, any direct or indirect damages for loss of profits) resulting or arising directly or indirectly from your participation in this campaign.
